categories.main_business_segments: The company operates four major business segments: General Automation (providing frequency converters, servo systems, PLC/HMI/CNC, industrial robots, high-performance motors, precision machinery, pneumatic components, sensors, and industrial vision solutions), New Energy Vehicles (providing electric drive systems and power systems for electric vehicles), Smart Elevators (providing elevator control systems, human-machine interfaces, door systems, and electrical solutions), and Rail Transit (providing traction and control systems for rail transportation). The company is a core component supplier in the intelligent manufacturing field.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in core technologies across five layers: information layer, control layer, drive layer, execution layer, and sensor layer. Key technologies include high-performance vector control, servo control, IGBT drive technology, PLC/CNC control, industrial vision, high-performance motor design, precision transmission mechanics, industrial software, and IoT technologies. The company employs IPD (Integrated Product Development) methodology for product development, combining technology research, platform product development, and customized product development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves diverse downstream industries including 3C manufacturing, textiles, injection molding, lithium batteries, semiconductors, machine tools, printing and packaging, air compressors, HVAC, construction machinery, metal products, cables, rubber and plastics, wind power, food and beverages, lifting equipment, metallurgy, coal mining, oil and gas, chemicals, building materials, and power generation. Primary end markets include industrial automation equipment manufacturers, new energy vehicle manufacturers, elevator manufacturers, and rail transit operators.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with headquarters in Shenzhen, China. It has established 18 subsidiaries and offices worldwide, with over 600 overseas employees. The company has developed over 130 overseas distributors across Southeast Asia, East Asia, Europe, India, Middle East and North Africa, and the Americas. Manufacturing and service facilities are located in multiple countries including Hungary, Thailand, and South Korea. The company maintains 42 authorized service centers, 10 spare parts centers, and 10 repair centers covering 28 countries and regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions. In industrial automation, it functions as a component and solution supplier to equipment manufacturers (midstream/downstream). In new energy vehicles, it operates as a Tier 1 supplier providing electric drive and power systems to vehicle manufacturers. In elevators, it supplies core components and integrated solutions to elevator manufacturers. In rail transit, it provides traction systems as a key component supplier. The company also engages in upstream activities through R&D and manufacturing of core components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic priorities include: (1) Internationalization - expanding global market presence through localized operations and 'borrowing ships to go overseas' strategy; (2) Digitalization - developing digital solutions through InoCube platform for equipment, energy, and factory digitalization; (3) Energy Management - providing smart energy solutions for power generation, distribution, and consumption; (4) AI Integration - developing industrial AI capabilities for product intelligence and operational optimization; (5) Humanoid Robots - entering the humanoid robot market with core component development. R&D investment in 2024 was 3.147 billion yuan (8.50% of revenue) with 5,538 R&D personnel.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales across four business segments. In General Automation, it uses a 'distribution-focused with direct sales' model, selling through distributors and system integrators to end customers, with direct sales to strategic customers. In New Energy Vehicles and Rail Transit, the company employs direct sales models to vehicle and transit operators. In Smart Elevators, it sells directly to elevator manufacturers. The company also generates revenue through service and support activities, and increasingly through digital solutions and energy management services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In General Automation, the company competes with international brands (Siemens, ABB, Yaskawa, Mitsubishi, Panasonic, Schneider, Fanuc) and holds leading market positions: servo systems 28.3% (1st), low-voltage frequency converters 18.6% (1st), medium-high voltage converters 18.6% (1st), small PLC 14.3% (2nd, 1st among domestic brands), industrial robots 8.8% (3rd). In New Energy Vehicles, it competes with international Tier 1 suppliers and domestic competitors, ranking 2nd in motor controllers (10.7%), 4th in integrated drive systems (6.3%). In Elevators, it competes with domestic suppliers and holds leading positions. In Rail Transit, main competitors are CRRC Times Electric and foreign brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a large-scale industrial automation enterprise with 2024 revenue of 37.04 billion yuan, representing 21.77% growth from 2023 (30.42 billion yuan). Net profit attributable to parent company was 4.285 billion yuan in 2024 (down 9.62% from 4.742 billion yuan in 2023). Total assets reached 57.18 billion yuan at year-end 2024 (up 16.79% from 48.96 billion yuan in 2023). The company has demonstrated strong growth over the past decade, with revenue growing from 23.01 billion yuan in 2022. Operating cash flow in 2024 was 7.20 billion yuan, more than double the prior year's 3.37 billion yuan.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's competitive differentiation is built on: (1) Multi-product integrated solutions - providing comprehensive automation solutions combining PLC, servo, frequency converters, and industrial robots rather than single products; (2) Industry-specific customization - offering tailored solutions for specific industries (elevators, new energy vehicles, rail transit) based on deep domain expertise; (3) Cost-performance advantage - providing high-quality products at competitive prices compared to international brands; (4) Rapid customer response - faster customization and delivery compared to foreign competitors; (5) Domestic brand leadership - leveraging position as China's industrial automation leader with government support for domestic substitution; (6) Integrated ecosystem - combining hardware, software, and digital solutions for comprehensive value delivery; (7) Technical depth - mastery of core technologies across multiple layers from sensors to control systems.
